يعلوط (form XIII)
# يَعْلَوِّطُ (yaʕlawwiṭu) /jaʕ.law.wi.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# يُعْلَوَّطُ (yuʕlawwaṭu) /juʕ.law.wa.tˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# يَعْلَوِّطَ (yaʕlawwiṭa) /jaʕ.law.wi.tˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِعْلَوَّطَ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
